cuts.title: 한글 프롬프트
cuts.prompt:
Cut 1 Prompt — “어떨까, 넌” Watercolor Album Cover

## 1) Image Style and Mood

A square contemporary Korean indie-pop album cover blending an ultra-realistic beauty portrait with delicate watercolor artwork.

The image feels quiet, poetic, dreamy, and emotionally restrained, as though the memory of one person has softly appeared on a sheet of paper.

Use a clean digital editorial finish with subtle handmade watercolor texture. Do not apply any film stock reference, analog film grain, vintage film coloration, light leaks, or cinematic film emulation.

The overall mood is wistful, intimate, and contemplative rather than bright, cute, cheerful, or dramatically sad.

## 2) Scene Concept and Story

Arin’s side-profile portrait quietly emerges from a wide bloom of pink watercolor.

She should not look like a conventional model posing for a beauty photograph. She appears more like a half-remembered person slowly returning to someone’s thoughts.

Her facial features remain recognizable and realistically rendered, while her neck, shoulders, clothing, and outer silhouette gradually dissolve into the white paper and translucent watercolor.

The portrait exists between a real person and a painted silhouette, preserving Arin’s identity while maintaining the symbolic simplicity of an emotional album cover.

## 3) Location, Format, and Environment

A minimal abstract album-art environment rather than a physical location.

Square 1:1 composition.

The base is clean white or softly warm ivory watercolor paper with a subtle natural paper texture.

There is no room, landscape, furniture, architecture, or realistic background.

The visual world consists only of:

- Arin’s profile portrait
- Organic pink watercolor washes
- Generous white negative space
- The exact handwritten Korean title “어떨까, 넌”
- A small subtle watermark

## 4) Background and Graphic Elements

Across the central portion of the paper, create a broad organic watercolor bloom made from layered raspberry pink, muted magenta, blush pink, dusty rose, and softly diluted burgundy.

The watercolor should appear absorbed naturally into paper, with irregular feathered edges, translucent overlaps, soft pigment pooling, and gentle variations in saturation.

Keep the watercolor expressive but uncluttered.

A very small amount of delicate pigment particles or faint luminous specks may appear inside the wash, only enough to add a quiet dreamlike feeling.

Do not add flowers, decorative frames, furniture, jewelry, abstract symbols, logos, music notes, stars, hearts, or unrelated props.

## 5) Camera Composition and Layout

Place Arin in the center-right or right side of the square frame.

Show her in a bust-length left-facing side profile.

Her face, jawline, short bob haircut, neck, and upper shoulder line remain clearly visible, while the lower bust and shoulder edges softly fade into the ivory paper and pink watercolor.

Her face should occupy enough space to remain identifiable but should not dominate the entire cover.

Leave broad, intentional negative space on the left side, directly in the direction of her gaze.

Place the title “어떨까, 넌” within this left-side negative space, slightly away from the exact center.

The title must not overlap her eyes, nose, lips, jawline, or the central facial silhouette.

Maintain a refined visual balance between the portrait, watercolor, title, and empty paper.

Avoid a crowded poster layout, symmetrical commercial advertising composition, or oversized typography.

## 6) Model Expression — Arin

Arin is a beautiful young Korean woman with a small V-line face, clear fair skin, large almond-shaped eyes with natural double eyelids, a straight high nose bridge, and soft pink lips.

She has a trendy dark-brown short bob haircut, between chin and collarbone length, styled with soft inward C-curls and light see-through bangs.

Her appearance is modern, clean, elegant, and sophisticated, with refined contemporary K-pop beauty.

### Pose and Gaze

Arin is shown in a calm left-facing side profile or very slight semi-profile.

She looks toward a distant point in the empty space, slightly downward or straight ahead.

She must not look directly at the camera.

Her chin is lifted only slightly so that the jawline and neck remain graceful and natural.

Her shoulders are lowered and relaxed.

No dramatic gestures are needed, and her hands do not need to appear.

One or two fine strands of hair may fall naturally beside her cheek.

### Expression

A quiet, emotionally contained expression.

Her lips are softly relaxed, neither smiling nor visibly sorrowful.

Her gaze suggests longing, curiosity, and a private memory she has not spoken aloud.

Avoid crying, exaggerated melancholy, a broad smile, seductive expressions, or theatrical emotion.

### Wardrobe

A minimal white, ivory, or extremely pale blush-pink top.

Use a lightweight soft material such as matte silk, fine chiffon, or smooth soft cotton.

The design is simple and undecorated, with no prints, lace, ruffles, buttons, jewelry, logos, or strong fashion details.

The clothing should gently disappear into the pale paper beneath her shoulders.

### Makeup

Fresh contemporary K-beauty makeup with a thin, clean, semi-glowing complexion.

Natural luminous skin with visible realistic texture.

Soft rose-beige and muted pink shading around the eyes.

Naturally defined eyelashes without heavy eyeliner.

A light diffused blush spread softly across the cheeks.

Moist rose-pink or subtle MLBB lips with a translucent finish.

The makeup should feel pure, refined, and emotional rather than sharp, glamorous, or heavily styled.

## 7) Lighting, Color, and Atmosphere

Use soft, even diffused lighting with a gentle front-side or diagonal side light.

Arin’s profile must remain readable, including her eye shape, nose bridge, lips, jawline, and skin texture.

Keep shadows very soft and restrained so the portrait visually connects with the flat watercolor surface.

Avoid dramatic chiaroscuro, strong rim light, hard shadows, clipped highlights, glossy commercial studio lighting, or strong three-dimensional sculpting.

Main palette:

- Raspberry pink
- Muted magenta
- Blush pink
- Dusty rose
- Soft burgundy
- White
- Warm ivory

Maintain Arin’s natural, clean skin tone.

The pink should feel lyrical and emotionally expressive rather than fluorescent, candy-colored, childish, or excessively romantic.

## 8) Typography and Key Direction

Render only the exact Korean title:

“어떨까, 넌”

Use a delicate, naturally flowing handwritten Korean calligraphy style.

The lettering should feel personal and emotional, as though written gently by hand with a brush pen.

Use deep muted purple, dark plum, or restrained burgundy ink.

Keep the original phrase clearly legible and preserve the comma exactly.

Place it in the negative space toward which Arin is looking.

Do not add the artist name, album information, English translation, upper caption, lower caption, central logo, the word “치즈,” or any additional Korean or English text.

Do not place the title directly over Arin’s face.

The final image should feel like a poetic memory preserved on watercolor paper: Arin’s real profile remains visible, while her body and silhouette gently dissolve into pink pigment and white emptiness.

## 9) Watermark

Add a small subtle watermark text “ⓒyulim_mood” in the bottom-right corner of the image.

Use Helvetica Neue font, thin or light weight.

The watermark should be white, semi-transparent, clean, minimal, and softly blended into the artwork.

cuts.title: 익숙한 아침
cuts.prompt:
Cut 1 Prompt - An Ordinary Morning

1) Photo Style and Mood
An ultra-realistic cinematic Korean romance music-video still photographed on Kodak Vision3 250D with the restrained softness of Kodak Portra 160. Cool steel-gray and muted blue tones, low contrast, fine analog grain, gentle highlight rolloff, realistic fluorescent lighting, and subtle optical vignetting. The mood is quiet, routine, slightly tired, and emotionally neutral.

2) Scene Concept and Story
Arin stands quietly in front of platform screen doors while morning commuters move around her with restrained motion blur. Arin remains still and sharply focused inside the moving crowd. No romantic counterpart appears. The scene represents a completely ordinary morning before anything meaningful begins.

3) Place, Time, Environment
A clean underground subway platform in a modern Korean business district at approximately 7:20 a.m. on a summer weekday. Cool ceiling lights, pale-gray flooring, glass platform doors, brushed-metal structures, and subtle commuter activity. No readable station names, signs, advertisements, logos, or display text.

4) Background and Props
Softly blurred commuters cross in front of and behind Arin. Include glass doors, metallic columns, restrained reflections, and long floor guide lines. Arin carries a structured black leather tote bag. Keep the setting realistic and uncluttered.

5) Camera Composition
Vertical 3:4. A wide full-body or knee-up shot with a 50mm lens at eye level. Place Arin slightly off-center with open space for moving commuters. Use platform frames and floor lines as leading lines. Add one softly blurred foreground commuter near the frame edge. Arin faces the tracks and looks beyond the doors, never at the camera.

6) Model Expression
Arin, a beautiful young Korean woman with a small V-line face, clear fair skin, large almond-shaped dark-brown eyes with natural double eyelids, a straight high nose bridge, soft pink lips, and a trendy chin-to-collarbone dark-brown bob with inward C-curls and light see-through bangs. Slim youthful figure, narrow waist, long elegant legs, realistic Korean proportions, healthy physique, graceful posture.

Outfit: light-gray oversized single-breasted blazer, cream short-sleeve knitted top, charcoal straight-leg slacks, structured black tote, minimal silver earrings, black pointed slingback shoes.

Makeup: clean professional morning makeup, even fair skin, muted peach-beige blush, natural brows, subtle brown eyeliner, lightly defined lashes, neutral-pink lips.

Expression and Pose: calm expression without expectation, relaxed lips, slightly tired but clear eyes. One hand holds the tote while the other rests naturally near the blazer side seam. Composed but not posed.

7) Lighting and Color
Use cool subway ceiling lights with soft frontal fill to prevent dark under-eye shadows. Maintain cool gray, steel blue, and cold white. Pink is almost absent. Keep Arin’s face gently brighter than the crowd. Add fine grain and soft optical vignetting.

8) Key Direction Points
The scene must feel genuinely ordinary, not dramatically lonely. Preserve realistic anatomy, natural hands, accurate footwear, believable reflections, and subtle motion blur. Avoid a romantic counterpart, direct camera gaze, exaggerated sadness, broad smiles, fantasy lighting, neon colors, dominant pink, readable text, and logos.

9) Watermark
Add a small subtle watermark text “ⓒyulim_mood” in the bottom-right corner. Use Helvetica Neue, thin or light weight, white, semi-transparent, clean, minimal, and softly blended into the photograph.

cuts.prompt:
Cut 2 Prompt - The First Interrupted Glance

1) Photo Style and Mood
An ultra-realistic cinematic Korean romance editorial still photographed on Kodak Vision3 250D with subtle Kodak Portra 160 softness. Cool low-contrast platform colors, fine 35mm grain, restrained highlights, shallow depth of field, and delicate optical vignetting. The mood is observant and emotionally restrained.

2) Scene Concept and Story
Arin waits for a train and casually turns her head about 15 to 20 degrees. A man’s blurred shoulder and pale shirt sleeve enter the extreme foreground. His face and identity remain hidden. Arin does not stare; only her eyes move toward him for a brief moment, as though she vaguely recognizes him. The reaction is not love or excitement, only a small interruption in her routine.

3) Place, Time, Environment
A modern underground subway platform in a Korean business district at approximately 7:20 a.m. on a summer weekday. Glass platform doors, cool ceiling lights, gray flooring, restrained metallic structures, and softly blurred commuters. No readable signs, advertisements, station names, logos, or display information.

4) Background and Props
The man’s out-of-focus shoulder occupies no more than 15 percent of one frame corner. Behind Arin are softly blurred screen doors and rectangular ceiling lights. A structured black tote hangs naturally from her hand or forearm. A faint dusty-pink reflection touches only one side of her cheek or blazer.

5) Camera Composition
Vertical 3:4. Over-the-shoulder medium close-up with an 85mm lens. The anonymous man’s shoulder forms a soft foreground frame while Arin remains sharply focused in a clear three-quarter profile. Her torso faces the tracks, her face turns slightly toward the foreground figure, and her eyes complete the final movement. She does not look at the camera.

6) Model Expression
Arin, a beautiful young Korean woman with a small V-line face, clear fair skin, large almond-shaped dark-brown eyes with natural double eyelids, a straight high nose bridge, soft pink lips, and a trendy short dark-brown bob with inward C-curls and light see-through bangs. Slim youthful figure, narrow waist, long elegant legs, realistic Korean anatomy, healthy physique, elegant posture.

Outfit: light-gray oversized blazer, cream short-sleeve knitted top, charcoal straight-leg slacks, structured black tote, minimal silver earrings, black pointed slingback shoes.

Makeup: luminous natural skin, subtle peach-pink blush, softly defined brown eyes, tiny catchlight, muted natural-pink lips.

Expression and Pose: almost neutral lips, relaxed eyebrows, brief sideways eye movement. The expression suggests “Have I seen him before?” rather than surprise.

7) Lighting and Color
Preserve cool fluorescent platform ambience. Use soft frontal fill to illuminate Arin’s eyes and create one small catchlight. Add an extremely subtle dusty-pink reflection along one cheek or blazer edge. Keep the foreground and outer frame gently darker.

8) Key Direction Points
The emotion must come from eye direction and timing, not dramatic expression. The man must remain unidentifiable. Avoid broad smiles, raised eyebrows, intense staring, direct camera gaze, physical interaction, strong pink lighting, readable text, and logos.

9) Watermark
Add a small subtle watermark text “ⓒyulim_mood” in the bottom-right corner. Use Helvetica Neue, thin or light weight, white, semi-transparent, clean, minimal, and softly blended.

cuts.title: 유리 속에 함께 담긴 두 사람
cuts.prompt:
Cut 3 Prompt - Reflections Beyond the Doors

1) Photo Style and Mood
An ultra-realistic cinematic commute portrait inspired by Kodak Vision3 250D with subtle Kodak Portra softness. Soft low contrast, fine analog grain, mixed cool and warm reflections, restrained color, wide dynamic range, and a quiet film-still atmosphere.

2) Scene Concept and Story
A subway train has arrived, creating overlapping layers between platform screen doors and train windows. Arin’s side profile appears clearly in the glass reflection. Farther away, the indistinct silhouette of an anonymous man appears only inside another reflected layer. They do not face each other directly. Arin pretends to observe the train door while quietly checking his reflected presence again. His face remains invisible, turned away or blocked by another commuter.

3) Place, Time, Environment
A modern underground subway platform in a Korean business district at approximately 7:20 a.m. on a summer weekday. A stopped train, layered windows, cool platform lighting, and restrained warm train-interior glow. No readable station names, route maps, advertisements, train numbers, logos, or digital text.

4) Background and Props
Layered glass panels, metallic vertical frames, soft train-interior light, subdued commuter silhouettes, and controlled reflections. Arin holds a structured black tote. The anonymous man appears only as a distant reflected shoulder-and-body silhouette. Avoid duplicated faces, distorted bodies, or excessive ghost images.

5) Camera Composition
Vertical 3:4. Layered medium shot using a 70mm lens, framed through the platform glass. Include a small portion of Arin’s real figure near one edge and her clearer reflected side profile in the central glass layer. Place the man only in a separate reflected layer farther away. Use vertical door frames to divide them. Arin looks toward the reflection, not at the camera.

6) Model Expression
Arin, a beautiful young Korean woman with a small V-line face, clear fair skin, large almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, straight high nose bridge, soft pink lips, and a trendy short dark-brown bob with inward C-curls and light see-through bangs. Slim youthful figure, narrow waist, long elegant legs, realistic Korean anatomy, healthy physique, elegant posture.

Outfit: light-gray oversized blazer, cream short-sleeve knitted top, charcoal straight-leg slacks, structured black tote, silver earrings, black pointed slingbacks.

Makeup: natural polished makeup, clear skin, soft peach-beige blush, understated brown eye definition, muted pink lips.

Expression and Pose: closed lips, calm thoughtful expression, eyes resting on the distant reflected silhouette while her body remains oriented toward the train.

7) Lighting and Color
Combine cool-white platform light around Arin with faint warm-peach glow around the reflected man. Introduce the first clearly perceptible peach-pink through train-interior light and glass reflection, but keep it restrained. Add fine grain, delicate bloom, soft highlight rolloff, and mild vignetting.

8) Key Direction Points
The scene should feel like two people briefly sharing one visual frame without meeting. Prioritize Arin’s reflected profile, controlled glass layers, and emotional distance. Avoid direct eye contact, visible male face, physical contact, strong smiles, crowded reflections, duplicated faces, fantasy overlays, readable text, and logos.

9) Watermark
Add a small subtle watermark text “ⓒyulim_mood” in the bottom-right corner. Use Helvetica Neue, thin or light weight, white, semi-transparent, clean, minimal, and softly blended.

cuts.prompt:
Cut 4 Prompt - Walking in the Same Direction

1) Photo Style and Mood
An ultra-realistic cinematic Korean romance still inspired by Fujifilm Pro 400H and Kodak Vision3 250D. Airy warm-gray architecture, pale powder-blue and ivory tones, cool pastel shadows, subtle mint undertones, low contrast, fine analog grain, and gentle telephoto compression. The mood is quietly familiar.

2) Scene Concept and Story
Inside a long subway connection corridor, an anonymous man walks several steps ahead while Arin travels in the same direction behind him. She is not following him; she is moving along her normal route. After recognizing his back, she briefly slows or adjusts her bag strap while maintaining a natural distance. Passing commuters intermittently cross between them. The man’s back, pale shirt, and simple dark bag remain visible, but his face stays concealed.

3) Place, Time, Environment
A long underground pedestrian corridor connecting a subway platform to a city exit at approximately 7:30 a.m. on a summer weekday. Warm-gray walls, repeating rectangular ceiling lights, polished flooring, glass or metal wall sections, and a bright warm-white opening at the distant end. No readable signs, advertisements, wayfinding text, logos, or station branding.

4) Background and Props
Repeating ceiling lights establish visual rhythm. Commuters create restrained foreground and midground layers. Arin carries a minimal leather shoulder bag. The man wears a pale neutral shirt, dark tailored trousers, clean formal shoes, and a simple dark work bag. Keep props unbranded.

5) Camera Composition
Vertical 3:4. Telephoto corridor shot using an 85mm or 105mm lens. Place the man slightly forward near the corridor’s visual center, softly out of focus. Keep Arin several steps behind and sharply focused. Use passing commuters as temporary foreground obstructions. Ceiling lights and wall lines direct the eye toward both figures. Arin briefly checks his back before looking forward.

6) Model Expression
Arin, a beautiful young Korean woman with a small V-line face, clear fair skin, large almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, straight high nose bridge, soft pink lips, and a short dark-brown bob with inward C-curls and light see-through bangs. Slim youthful figure, narrow waist, long elegant legs, anatomically accurate Korean proportions, healthy physique, graceful posture.

Outfit: powder-blue shirt, ivory long tailored vest, cream wide-leg trousers, minimal leather shoulder bag, thin metal wristwatch, white loafers.

Makeup: fresh neutral makeup, clear skin, cool peach blush, softly defined eyes, natural lashes, pale rose lips.

Expression and Pose: restrained recognition, “There he is again.” Face mostly neutral, eyes carrying a small spark of familiarity. One hand lightly adjusts the bag strap while she walks.

7) Lighting and Color
Use repeating ceiling lights as rhythmic illumination with warmer glow at the corridor’s far end. Expose Arin’s powder-blue and ivory outfit clearly against the warm-gray background. Keep skin clean and neutral. Add delicate pale-peach warmth, fine grain, and soft edge vignetting.

8) Key Direction Points
Show recognition without implying pursuit. Maintain believable distance. Keep Arin casual and socially natural. Avoid visible male face, backward glance from the man, physical contact, dramatic longing, theatrical poses, readable signs, and logos.

9) Watermark
Add a small subtle watermark text “ⓒyulim_mood” in the bottom-right corner. Use Helvetica Neue, thin or light weight, white, semi-transparent, clean, minimal, and softly blended.

A clean glass wall with subtle pale-peach and lilac reflections, passing commuter silhouettes, repeating overhead lights, and minimal architectural lines. Arin carries a minimal leather shoulder bag. Vertical 3:4. Medium shot using a 70mm lens that includes both Arin’s real figure and the glass reflection. Place the boundary between reality and reflection near the central third. Her body continues forward while her gaze angles toward the reflection. She never looks at the camera.

7) Lighting and Color
Use soft corridor illumination with clean neutral skin tones. Allow thin pale-peach and pale-lilac bands across the glass, keeping them physically plausible. Keep the center gently bright and outer edges softly darker. Add fine grain and restrained highlight bloom.

---

## 2) Scene Concept and Story

Jieun has come alone to the frozen riverside where her father was last seen.

Between frozen soil and uneven snow, she notices one small red camellia blooming in unnatural silence.

She lowers herself onto one knee before it.

She does not pick the flower.

She does not touch its petals.

Her right fingertips stop several centimeters away, as though respecting the boundary between a living memory and something that must remain where it grew.

Her left hand holds the heavy coat collar close to her chest, not to create a fashionable pose, but to block the cold and feel the physical weight of the person who once wore it.

### Narrative Anchor

Jieun finally understands, through the flower, that someone became winter in her place so that she could remain alive.

This is not the moment when grief begins.

She has already cried for a long time.

This is the first moment when she looks beyond her father’s death and begins to see the life he left for her.

The frame must simultaneously contain:

cuts.title: 바람이 커버업을 부풀리는 순간
cuts.prompt:
# CUT 01 Prompt — Wind Inside the Cover-Up

## 1) Film Reference and Color Palette

Create an ultra-realistic vertical 3:4 natural resort lifestyle photograph captured on Kodak Portra 160 120 medium-format color-negative film, exposed at approximately EI 125 and professionally scanned with a restrained neutral lab finish.

Kodak Portra 160 must define the complete frame through:

- exceptionally fine organic grain
- low-contrast coastal daylight
- creamy white sand
- restrained pastel coastal blue
- deep but readable navy
- warm-neutral Korean skin
- softly open shadows
- smooth highlight rolloff
- delicate midtone separation
- gently softened analog edge acuity
- subtle color-density variation

The photograph must feel like a spontaneous vacation snapshot taken by a close travel companion, not a swimwear campaign, luxury resort advertisement, or posed fashion editorial.

Preserve the translucent texture of the white cover-up and readable shadow detail in the navy bikini. Avoid clipped white fabric, crushed navy shadows, excessive turquoise saturation, glossy digital contrast, or artificial HDR recovery.

## 2) Scene Concept and Story

It is Seorin’s first late morning in Warnemünde on the German Baltic coast.

After leaving her luggage at the accommodation, she has walked directly toward the beach wearing a minimal navy bikini beneath a lightweight white cover-up.

She is not walking for the camera. She is slowly following the edge of the water, confirming through her bare feet and skin that the long journey has finally ended.

Narrative anchor:

Seorin walks barefoot across the sand because she wants to remember the temperature of the wind, the softness of the beach, and the first sound of the Baltic waves.

Capture the transitional instant when the sea breeze enters the open cover-up and briefly inflates the fabric behind her.

## 3) Location, Time and Environment

- Warnemünde white-sand beach, German Baltic coast
- early July
- approximately 10:30–11:30 a.m.
- bright late-morning daylight softened by intermittent thin clouds
- broad pale sand
- calm Baltic waves
- low irregular sea foam
- small distant sailboats
- moderate sea breeze moving from the water toward the shore

The environment should communicate warm sunlight and cool wind at the same time.

## 4) Background and Props

Construct progressive background depth:

- foreground: a softly blurred edge of beach grass or low sea foam passing close to the lens
- midground: Seorin walking barefoot near the wet-dry sand boundary
- background: the long Baltic horizon, tiny sailboats and softly separated clouds

Do not place the horizon directly through the center of the frame. Position it near the upper third or slightly below the middle, preserving generous negative space.

Seorin carries a natural rattan net bag featuring:

- irregular woven spacing
- naturally inconsistent fiber thickness
- subtly uneven handmade construction
- small shells with slightly different shapes and colors
- several shells tilted in different directions
- gentle signs of use
- one loosely folded ivory towel visible inside

Wardrobe:

- minimal deep navy bikini with a clean, non-decorative design
- ultra-light white cover-up cardigan
- loosely woven gauze-cotton or semi-sheer fabric
- long sleeves hanging near the wrists but pushed unevenly by the wind
- bare feet
- no visible statement jewelry

## 5) Camera and Composition

- vertical 3:4 frame
- full-frame mirrorless camera
- 35mm lens
- f/3.2
- camera height approximately 95–105cm
- rear three-quarter viewpoint, approximately 65–75° from her direction of movement
- environmental full-body wide shot

Place Seorin slightly left of the lower center. Sand, sea and sky should occupy approximately 65% of the composition.

Capture a natural walking transition:

- left foot supporting her weight
- right foot just leaving the sand
- slight sand displacement under the supporting foot
- right shoulder gently opened toward her walking direction
- torso leaning only slightly with the movement
- no runway stride
- no exaggerated hip rotation

Her face should appear only as an incomplete 20–30° profile.

Gaze direction: toward the waterline ahead.

Camera eye contact: none.

### Hands and Physical Contact

Her right hand lightly carries the net-bag handle:

- thumb and index finger support the handle
- middle and ring fingers curve naturally around it
- little finger may remain slightly separated
- wrist aligned naturally with the forearm

Her left arm swings loosely beside her body.

Default free hand:

- hand relaxed
- fingers naturally separated
- wrist aligned

The bag must not penetrate or merge with her thigh. Maintain a small physical gap or believable contact shadow where the swinging bag approaches the leg.

## 6) Model Expression

Seorin is a beautiful adult Korean woman with:

- a small slim oval face
- a soft V-line jaw
- fair luminous skin
- large clear dark-brown almond-shaped eyes
- soft natural double eyelids
- subtle aegyo-sal
- gently lifted outer eye corners
- a small straight nose with a softly rounded tip
- naturally full soft-pink lips
- long dark-brown to soft-black layered wavy hair
- a center part with soft face-framing strands
- a pure, warm, affectionate and graceful presence
- a slender feminine figure with softly balanced proportions

# 서린(Seorin) × 견우와 직녀 — THE ONE NIGHT THE STARS REMEMBER
# SET 05 — UNTIL THE BRIDGE RETURNS / 새벽, 다시 기약
# CUT 05 — A YEAR UNTIL THE NEXT EMBRACE / 다시 보려면 1년
# Model: Seorin / Shooting Date: 2026.08.11
# Vertical 3:4 / Person-Reference Image Mode / Seorin + Gyeonwoo
# Editorial Direction: K-Fusion Historical Fantasy Romance × Celestial Dawn Farewell × Korean Pastel Historical Editorial × Intimate Emotional Cinema × Final Embrace Portrait
# Primary Emotional Medium: tears, embrace pressure, gripping hands and the physical warmth of a farewell that neither person wants to end
# Core Motif: Seorin’s tear-filled face against Gyeonwoo’s shoulder and neckline, her hands gripping his clothing, pale-lavender Korean costume, loosened dark hair and the last blue-lavender light before separation
# Emotional Direction: the sadness of having to wait another full year, not hopeless collapse but an intimate near-breaking moment created by holding him more tightly because she does not want to let go

## 0) Reference Facial Identity, Target Hair and Makeup Priority

The person in the attached reference image portrays Seorin in this final scene. Treat the attached reference image as the sole facial identity source for Seorin.

Preserve exactly the same recognizable facial proportions, actual eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, nose, lips, cheek structure, jawline, skin tone, apparent adult age, natural facial asymmetry, beauty marks and every distinctive identity cue.

The extreme close framing, emotional crying, cheek compression and embrace must never redesign her into another person. Preserve her actual eye size, nose shape, lip dimensions, jaw structure, facial width and age impression even while her expression changes strongly.

The name “Seorin” defines narrative persona and emotional behavior only; it does not define a replacement face.

Use only MANDATORY TARGET-HAIR OVERRIDE MODE.

Completely replace the hairstyle visible in the reference with the SET5 target hairstyle. Render long deep dark-brown to soft-black hair extending below the chest and continuing down the upper-to-mid back, although much of the total length falls outside this close frame.

Most hair is released and loose, with relaxed irregular low-S waves rather than polished curls. Keep a natural near-center part, no heavy bangs and soft reduced crown volume. Only a very small upper portion remains loosely gathered behind the head.

Because Seorin is pressing herself into Gyeonwoo’s embrace, several extremely fine temple wisps and side strands become slightly displaced around the temples, ears and outer cheek. This looseness must result naturally from physical contact rather than looking deliberately styled.

Use one slender restrained silver binyeo-inspired pin and one small jade gogok accent. They should be identifiable only on close inspection and must never compete with the emotional face.

Do not retain the SET3 formal eoyeomeori, crown structure, braid, ponytail, compact bun, perfectly fixed half-up structure, heavy fringe or any conflicting source-hair silhouette.

The target hairstyle must not alter Seorin’s facial identity.

The makeup visible in the reference is not an identity constraint. Replace it with the SET5 dawn makeup and the physically realistic effects of crying only as surface color, texture, moisture and reflectance.

## 1) Capture Pipeline and Film Character

Create an emotionally intimate full-frame photograph using an 85–105mm portrait lens at approximately f/1.8–f/2.0.

Use Fujifilm Pro 400H-inspired tonal behavior: airy cool pastel color, restrained cyan undertone, softly lifted blacks, low-to-moderate contrast, delicate skin reproduction, fine organic grain and subdued saturation.

Adapt that normally airy film character to the increased emotional density of this final image. Keep the background pale and soft while allowing the faces, tears, compressed fabric and hands to retain enough local contrast to feel physically close.

Use a palette of pale lavender, blue-gray, mist ivory, faded silver and only a small amount of pale peach from the approaching horizon.

Do not use dramatic orange-versus-teal grading, harsh digital clarity or artificial HDR.

## 2) Scene Concept and Narrative

This image replaces the former hopeful direct-gaze finale.

Seorin and Gyeonwoo are at the final moment before they must separate until the next Chilseok.

The emotional priority is not the abstract hope of meeting again. The first thing the viewer must feel is that Seorin does not want this embrace to end because the next embrace is one full year away.

She is fully inside Gyeonwoo’s arms and presses her upper-body weight toward him.

This is not a decorative couple pose. Their clothing, shoulders and hands must show real contact pressure.

Seorin is emotionally close to breaking down, but the image must remain intimate and believable rather than theatrical melodrama.

Gyeonwoo functions primarily as the physical space that contains Seorin’s grief. He is a supporting adult male figure rather than the visual protagonist.

Do not display Gyeonwoo’s entire face as a competing portrait. Show only a restrained partial cheek or jaw if composition requires it, together with his neck, shoulder, upper torso and arms.

Create an EXTREME CLOSE-UP EMOTIONAL TWO-SHOT using approximately 100mm at f/1.8–f/2.0.

Place the camera at almost exact eye level or only slightly above Seorin’s eyes.

The composition must include all of the following within one coherent frame:

Gyeonwoo’s shoulder and neckline,
enough of Gyeonwoo’s upper torso to establish the embrace,
Gyeonwoo’s embracing arms,
Seorin’s right hand gripping near his shoulder or collar,

Express the bust volume through believable anatomical projection, realistic silk curvature and subtle fabric tension before and during the embrace.

The contact with Gyeonwoo may create plausible soft compression, but the chest remains visibly natural rather than flattened or pushed upward unnaturally.

Most importantly, do not tuck the jeogori into the skirt in order to emphasize bust volume.

## 9) Makeup, Tears and Emotional Expression

Use cool muted dawn makeup beneath realistic crying.

The skin retains natural pores, fine facial vellus hair, subtle under-eye tonal variation and localized matte-to-satin reflectance.

Do not smooth the skin into porcelain or glass.

Now layer physically realistic emotional moisture over this makeup.

A clearly visible moisture film collects along the lower eye line.

The lower eyelids lift subtly from emotion without changing Seorin’s actual eye anatomy.

The inner ends of the eyebrows lift only slightly while the glabella contracts approximately 10–20%, creating believable sadness without permanently moving the eyebrow position.

Tears must follow natural gravity and cheek curvature. Use narrow irregular moisture paths rather than perfectly symmetrical glossy lines.

Her lips are not smiling.

Do not create a wide open mouth, screaming, grimacing or exaggerated sobbing.

The facial emotion is the instant just before composure gives way: she understands that she must release him, but her body is still refusing.

NO CAMERA GAZE.

Seorin’s gaze stays at extremely close distance, directed toward the area beneath Gyeonwoo’s neck, his shoulder or the clothing immediately in front of her.

Keep her eyes approximately half-open rather than tightly shut.

The pupils remain oriented coherently toward this nearby point.

Her eyes must retain emotional visibility despite the lowered intimate gaze.

The first emotional reading must be “she does not want to let go,” not “she is hopeful about next year.”

The embrace must show believable body pressure.

Seorin’s cheek, hair and clothing create realistic contact shadows against Gyeonwoo.

The shoulder and chest fabrics compress where their bodies meet.

# SET 05 / CUT 24 Prompt — The First Cold Step

## 0) Reference Facial Identity, Target Hair and Makeup Priority

The person in the attached person-reference image portrays Suji in this Vacation Editorial scene.

Treat the attached person-reference image as the sole facial identity source.

Preserve the exact same recognizable person, including her actual facial proportions, eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, cheek structure, skin tone, apparent adult age, natural facial asymmetry, beauty marks, hairline and every distinctive identity cue.

Do not reconstruct the face from Suji’s canonical appearance, do not blend identities, do not idealize perfect symmetry and do not create another vacation model.

The name “Suji” defines only controlled sensory awareness, calm physical coordination, quiet confidence and the ability to accept the first cold touch of water without losing her deliberate pace.

### TARGET-HAIR OVERRIDE MODE — MANDATORY

Replace the hairstyle shown in the attached reference image completely.

The final image must show long glossy dark espresso-brown layered hair extending clearly below the chest and ending around the mid-back.

Use broad relaxed layered S-waves, a clean center part, no bangs, natural polished root volume and long face-framing layers beginning below the cheekbones.

The hair remains loose and untied.

Because she is taking the first step into the pool, the upper hair and most of the length remain dry.

Several lower ends near the back may receive small droplets or light humidity, but the hair must not become fully wet or slicked back.

Keep most of the hair behind both shoulders.

Allow the lower S-wave ends to move slightly behind her as she leans forward for balance.

Keep both eyes, cheeks, jawline, neck, square neckline, hands and handrail clearly separated from the hair.

Do not retain conflicting source hair length, silhouette, curls, parting, bangs, tied structure or color.

Do not render a bob, short hair, collarbone-length ends, tight curls, side part, bangs, ponytail, braid, bun or fully wet slicked-back hairstyle.

Preserve the exact same recognizable facial identity throughout the hairstyle replacement.

### TARGET MAKEUP PRIORITY — SOFT WET SPA MAKEUP

Replace the visible source makeup with soft wet spa makeup.

Use a very thin water-resistant sheer base retaining realistic pores, fine facial hair, natural tonal irregularity and facial micro-detail.

Use soft-taupe or rose-beige non-smudging cream shadow, an extremely thin waterproof brown tightline and separated waterproof lashes.

Apply transparent rose-coral cream blush and a transparent rose or peach moisture lip.

Keep makeup shine restrained and distinct from water droplets.

Do not allow mascara or eyeliner to run.

Do not alter the actual facial anatomy, skin tone, adult age or natural asymmetry.

## 1) Vacation Editorial, Film and Format

Create an ultra-realistic water-level Vacation Editorial image inside a private luxury-villa pool at night.

Captured digitally with a high-resolution full-frame camera and color-graded to evoke CineStill 800T.

Use deep midnight blue, cyan and teal underwater highlights, warm amber villa separation, restrained red-orange practical-light halation, controlled organic grain, cinematic low-light density and readable shadows.

Preserve realistic skin tone and ice-blue satin detail under the mixed lighting.

Vertical 3:4 composition.

## 2) Narrative and Editorial Intent

Suji holds the metal handrail and slowly enters the pool.

Her right foot reaches the lower submerged step while the left foot remains in transition from the step above.

The first cold contact causes a brief intake of breath and a small physical response in the shoulders.

She does not rush, jump or recoil dramatically.

The image captures the exact balance between sensory reaction and retained control.

## 3) Location and Background

Use the submerged entry steps of the private infinity pool.

The steps are dark stone with depth-dependent teal coloration and slight surface wear.

A brushed-metal handrail curves into the pool.

The water is calm before her entry but develops small outward ripples around the legs and moving left hand.

### Background Layers

Foreground: water surface and several broken reflected light bands close to the lens.

Midground: Suji entering the water, handrail, both hands, satin lounge set, steps and waterline.

Background: infinity edge, warm villa windows, dark roofline and midnight sky.

Maintain progressive optical depth and keep reflected light away from the eyes.

## 4) Wardrobe, Fuller Bust and Wet-Satin Mechanics

Suji wears the ice-blue heavy-satin lounge set with broad deep square neckline, French Chantilly lace cuffs, wide trousers and silk ribbon beneath the bust.

The square-neck top contains shaped demi-cups, water-resistant supportive lining, flexible underbust cradle, restrained side-support panels and vertical shaping seams.

Maintain a visibly fuller, softly rounded bust by one controlled styling level.

Keep the volume anatomically integrated with the rib cage, shoulders, waist and arms.

The upper body remains securely contained while Suji leans slightly forward.

Do not flatten the chest because of the forward lean or waterline.

Do not create rigid spherical breasts, extreme cleavage compression, exaggerated lift or garment instability.

The waterline crosses the trousers and lower torso at a physically plausible height.

Wet heavy satin becomes darker, heavier and closer to the body above the waterline.

Below the surface it moves slowly, with refraction and depth-related color change.

The ribbon and neckline remain connected and stable.

Full-frame camera, 50mm lens, aperture f/2.8.

Camera height: approximately 5–12cm above the water surface.

Position the camera 45–55° toward the left-front side of the stair direction.

Include the complete head, target hair, face, shoulders, fuller square-neck bodice, both hands, handrail, torso and legs down to approximately the submerged knees.

Show the face above the water and the garment distortion beneath the water simultaneously.

Her gaze is directed toward the next submerged step.

Keep the heel, forefoot and toes supported.

The left foot leaves the higher step and moves downward.

Maintain the correct height difference between the two feet and knees.

Keep the left fingers separated directly beneath the water, allowing them to part the water and create small ripples.

Part the lips approximately 1–2mm for a short intake of breath.

## 9) Essential Direction and Physical Anchors

The two feet must occupy correct different stair heights.

The right foot must make full contact with the lower step.

The right hand must grip the handrail with visible moisture and contact shadow.

The left submerged fingers remain distinct and generate small realistic ripples.

The fuller bust remains securely supported during the forward lean and water entry.

The long target hair retains below-chest to mid-back length and remains mostly dry.

Suji has just entered the room. She does not dominate the light through force. She quietly tests whether the reflective world has begun to follow her movement.

## 3) Location, Time and Environment

The scene takes place in deep night after all exterior daylight has disappeared. The room is fully enclosed, silent and slightly humid, with a few fine atmospheric particles visible only when they cross the narrow light beams.

Her left arm hangs beside the thigh with the wrist aligned and the fingers naturally separated.

The hairstyle must remain the specified sleek dark-brown wet-look low ponytail: clean center part, no bangs, low crown volume, smooth side sections, nape tie and a straight weighted ponytail ending at mid-back. A narrow silver rim light may trace its outer edge, but the hair must not float or split into multiple unrelated tails.

She has stopped naturally after walking, with one foot still half a step ahead. An antique gold pocket watch hangs loosely from one lowered hand, while her other arm rests naturally beside her body. ## 3) Location, Time, and Environment

The front terrace of the Orangery Palace in Potsdam, Germany, during a quiet early-summer morning between 8:10 and 9:10 a.m.

Soft late-afternoon key light begins slightly left of center and above face height, visually carrying memory toward the present while remaining credible daylight. The archive begins darker and denser; toward center it gradually opens; the right zone resolves into clean natural light.
